👇 Or build the order by tapping: first pick the customer, then the product.
tapflow.customer.ask: 👤 Type the new customer's name. You can add the phone and address too, for example: Hina 03331234567 Johar Town
tapflow.order.product: 👇 Tap a product (1 piece). For more, type it, for example: {0} 3
tapflow.expense.next: ✍️ Now type the expense, for example: rent 3000
tapflow.wage.next: ✍️ Now type who was paid how much, for example: Ali 1500
tapflow.unpaid.pick: 👇 Got the money? Tap the customer and the order is marked paid. If it was a mistake, type "undo".
